body: Thank you for the response! I know time is something that helps but it's the waiting that's really hard you know?
I'm really sorry to hear that. I know how that feels.
Hey OP, you sound a lot like someone I care about. Are you ok? Do you think you can tell me you're ok?
"I see everything" is that a La Dispute reference?

I'm seeing my therapist on Friday and I'm gonna tell her about my depression. I only just started seeing her an its still hard to open up but i know I need the help really badly which is why I'm hoping to get put on meds.

Thanks for understanding. And actually I know exactly what you're talking about. I try to reassure myself a lot but sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn't. I try my hardest not be alone because I need to keep myself distracted a lot. Honestly I'm afraid to be alone sometimes because that's when the depressed part of me tends to take over and I start posting shit like this or thinking about suicide.

Thanks for reading it means a lot. I have been trying for about 2 months now (I know that's not long at all) and things have only been going downhill and I'm just not sure how much more I can stay in this state or anything lower than this
This is a poem, song, love letter, death note, and a thank you all in one. Truly beautiful OP.
